title: GraphRAG on Consumer Hardware: Benchmarking Local LLMs for Healthcare EHR Schema Retrieval
why_relevant: Benchmarks local LLMs in a GraphRAG pipeline and mentions hallucination differences between retrieval modes, but focuses on deployment feasibility rather than robustness to unreliable evidence.
why_not_or_caveat: Application-focused evaluation in healthcare; does not study noise, conflict, adversaries, or calibration in a principled way.
